093  private static String getProperties(TunableConfig config) {
094    String properties = config == null ? "{}" : config.getProperties();
095    StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder(properties.length() + 32);
096    sb.append(properties, 0, properties.length() - 1);
097    if (sb.length() > 1) {
098      sb.append(',');
099    }
100    if (config != null && config.isRobust()) {
101      sb.append("\"robust\":true,");
102    }
103    sb.append("\"mutable\":").append(config == null || config.isMutable()).append(',');
104    sb.setCharAt(sb.length() - 1, '}');
105    return sb.toString();
106  }

113  }

115  private static boolean isAlwaysGet(TunableBase tunable) {
116    TunableConfig config = tunable.getConfig();
117    return config != null && config.getPolling() == TunableConfig.Polling.ALWAYS_GET;
118  }
119
120  private record InitialUpdate(Runnable callback) {}
121
122  private abstract class TunableValueEntry implements TunableEntry {
123    TunableValueEntry(String path, TunableBase tunable, TunableConfig config, String typeString) {
124      m_path = path;
125      m_tunable = tunable;
126      if (config != null && config.getTypeString() != null) {
127        typeString = config.getTypeString();
128      }
129      if (config != null && config.isRobust()) {
130        m_publisher =
131            m_inst.getTopic(path + "/value").genericPublishEx(typeString, getProperties(config));
132        m_subscriber =
133            m_inst
134                .getTopic(path + "/tune")
135                .genericSubscribe(typeString, PubSubOption.excludePublisher(m_publisher));
136      } else {
137        var topic = m_inst.getTopic(path);
138        m_publisher = topic.genericPublishEx(typeString, getProperties(config));
139        m_subscriber =
140            topic.genericSubscribe(typeString, PubSubOption.excludePublisher(m_publisher));
141      }
142      m_subscriberMap.put(m_subscriber.getHandle(), this);
143      if (config == null || config.isMutable()) {
144        boolean applyInitialValue = config != null && config.isRobust();
145        var eventKinds = EnumSet.of(NetworkTableEvent.Kind.VALUE_ALL);
146        if (applyInitialValue) {
147          eventKinds.add(NetworkTableEvent.Kind.IMMEDIATE);
148        }
149        m_listener = m_poller.addListener(m_subscriber, eventKinds);
150        if (applyInitialValue) {
151          // NT queues the initial snapshot atomically with listener registration.
152          // A separate subscriber read could apply a racing write twice.
153          for (var event : m_poller.readQueue()) {
154            if (event.listener == m_listener && event.is(NetworkTableEvent.Kind.IMMEDIATE)) {
155              // Immediate events include the topic's value even if the subscription
156              // is inactive because another type is already published.
157              if (event.valueData != null
158                  && typeString.equals(m_subscriber.getTopic().getTypeString())) {
159                m_initialValue = event.valueData.value;
160              }
161            } else {
162              m_pendingTuneEvents.add(event);
163            }
164          }
165        }
166      } else {
167        m_listener = 0;
168      }
169      m_onChange = config == null ? null : config.getOnTune();
170    }
171
172    @Override
173    public void close() {
174      if (m_listener != 0) {
175        m_poller.removeListener(m_listener);
176      }
177      m_subscriberMap.remove(m_subscriber.getHandle());
178      m_subscriber.close();
179      m_publisher.close();
180    }
181
182    @Override
183    public abstract void updateNetwork();
184
185    protected abstract boolean doUpdateTunable(NetworkTableValue value);
186
187    public Runnable updateTunable(NetworkTableValue value) {
188      if (!doUpdateTunable(value)) {
189        return null;
190      }
191      TunableRegistry.recordTuneApplied(m_tunable);
192      m_forcePublish = true;
193      return m_onChange;
194    }
195
196    public InitialUpdate updateInitialTunable() {
197      NetworkTableValue value = m_initialValue;
198      m_initialValue = null;
199      if (value == null || !value.isValid()) {
200        return null;
201      }
202      return new InitialUpdate(updateTunable(value));
203    }
204
205    protected boolean shouldPublishValue(boolean changed) {
206      boolean shouldPublish = m_forcePublish || changed;
207      m_forcePublish = false;
208      return shouldPublish;
209    }
210
211    protected void reportWarning(String msg) {
212      TunableRegistry.reportWarning("NetworkTables tunable '" + m_path + "': " + msg);
213    }
214
215    protected void reportWarning(String msg, Exception e) {
216      reportWarning(msg + ": " + e);
217    }
218
219    protected void reportNullValueRetained(String valueDescription, boolean hasPublishedValue) {
220      if (hasPublishedValue) {
221        reportWarning(
222            "null " + valueDescription + " value was not published; previous value retained");
223      }
224    }
225
226    protected final String m_path;
227    protected final GenericPublisher m_publisher;
228    protected final GenericSubscriber m_subscriber;
229    private final TunableBase m_tunable;
230    private final int m_listener;
231    private final Runnable m_onChange;
232    private NetworkTableValue m_initialValue;
233    private boolean m_forcePublish;
234  }

236  private final class TunableBooleanEntry extends TunableValueEntry {
237    TunableBooleanEntry(
238        String path,
239        TunableBase tunable,
240        TunableConfig config,
241        BooleanSupplier getter,
242        BooleanConsumer setter) {
243      super(path, tunable, config, "boolean");
244      m_getter = getter;
245      m_setter = setter;
246      updateNetwork();
247    }
248
249    @Override
250    public void updateNetwork() {
251      boolean value = m_getter.getAsBoolean();
252      if (shouldPublishValue(!m_hasLastValue || value != m_lastValue)) {
253        m_lastValue = value;
254        m_hasLastValue = true;
255        m_publisher.setBoolean(value);
256      }
257    }
258
259    @Override
260    public boolean doUpdateTunable(NetworkTableValue value) {
261      m_setter.accept(value.getBoolean());
262      return true;
263    }
264
265    private final BooleanSupplier m_getter;
266    private final BooleanConsumer m_setter;
267    private boolean m_lastValue;
268    private boolean m_hasLastValue;
269  }

411  @FunctionalInterface
412  private interface ValuePublisher<T> {
413    void publish(GenericPublisher publisher, T value);
414  }
415
416  @FunctionalInterface
417  private interface ValueReader<T> {
418    T read(NetworkTableValue value);
419  }
420
421  private final class NullableTunableValueEntry<T> extends TunableValueEntry {
422    NullableTunableValueEntry(
423        String path,
424        Tunable<T> tunable,
425        String typeString,
426        ValuePublisher<T> valuePublisher,
427        ValueReader<T> valueReader) {
428      super(path, tunable, tunable.getConfig(), typeString);
429      m_tunables = tunable;
430      m_valueDescription = typeString;
431      m_valuePublisher = valuePublisher;
432      m_valueReader = valueReader;
433      updateNetwork();
434    }
435
436    @Override
437    public void updateNetwork() {
438      T value = m_tunables.get();
439      if (value == null) {
440        shouldPublishValue(false);
441        reportNullValueRetained(m_valueDescription, m_hasLastValue);
442      } else if (shouldPublishValue(!m_hasLastValue || !value.equals(m_lastValue))) {
443        m_lastValue = value;
444        m_hasLastValue = true;
445        m_valuePublisher.publish(m_publisher, value);
446      }
447    }
448
449    @Override
450    public boolean doUpdateTunable(NetworkTableValue value) {
451      m_tunables.set(m_valueReader.read(value));
452      return true;
453    }
454
455    private final Tunable<T> m_tunables;
456    private final String m_valueDescription;
457    private final ValuePublisher<T> m_valuePublisher;
458    private final ValueReader<T> m_valueReader;
459    private T m_lastValue;
460    private boolean m_hasLastValue;
461  }

463  private final class TunableRawEntry extends TunableValueEntry {
464    TunableRawEntry(String path, Tunable<byte[]> tunable) {
465      super(path, tunable, tunable.getConfig(), "raw");
466      m_tunables = tunable;
467      updateNetwork();
468    }
469
470    @Override
471    public void updateNetwork() {
472      byte[] value = m_tunables.get();
473      if (value == null) {
474        shouldPublishValue(false);
475        reportNullValueRetained("raw", m_lastValue != null);
476        return;
477      }
478      if (shouldPublishValue(!Arrays.equals(value, m_lastValue))) {
479        m_lastValue = Arrays.copyOf(value, value.length);
480        m_publisher.setRaw(value, 0, value.length);
481      }
482    }
483
484    @Override
485    public boolean doUpdateTunable(NetworkTableValue value) {
486      m_tunables.set(value.getRaw());
487      return true;
488    }
489
490    private final Tunable<byte[]> m_tunables;
491    private byte[] m_lastValue;
492  }

525  private final class TunableIntArrayEntry extends TunableValueEntry {
526    TunableIntArrayEntry(String path, Tunable<int[]> tunable) {
527      super(path, tunable, tunable.getConfig(), "int[]");
528      m_tunables = tunable;
529      updateNetwork();
530    }
531
532    @Override
533    public void updateNetwork() {
534      int[] value = m_tunables.get();
535      if (value == null) {
536        shouldPublishValue(false);
537        reportNullValueRetained("int array", m_lastValue != null);
538        return;
539      }
540      if (shouldPublishValue(!Arrays.equals(value, m_lastValue))) {
541        m_lastValue = Arrays.copyOf(value, value.length);
542        m_publisher.setIntegerArray(toLongArray(value));
543      }
544    }
545
546    @Override
547    public boolean doUpdateTunable(NetworkTableValue value) {
548      m_tunables.set(fromLongArray(value.getIntegerArray()));
549      return true;
550    }
551
552    @SuppressWarnings("PMD.AvoidArrayLoops")
553    private static long[] toLongArray(int[] arr) {
554      long[] result = new long[arr.length];
555      for (int i = 0; i < arr.length; i++) {
556        result[i] = arr[i];
557      }
558      return result;
559    }
560
561    private static int[] fromLongArray(long[] arr) {
562      int[] result = new int[arr.length];
563      for (int i = 0; i < arr.length; i++) {
564        result[i] = (int) arr[i];
565      }
566      return result;
567    }
568
569    private int[] m_lastValue;
570    private final Tunable<int[]> m_tunables;
571  }

697  private final class TunableStructEntry<T> extends TunableValueEntry {
698    TunableStructEntry(String path, Tunable.TunableStruct<T> tunable) {
699      super(path, tunable, tunable.getConfig(), tunable.getStruct().getTypeString());
700      m_tunables = tunable;
701      m_buf = StructBuffer.create(tunable.getStruct());
702      updateNetwork();
703    }
704
705    @SuppressWarnings("PMD.AvoidCatchingGenericException")
706    @Override
707    public void updateNetwork() {
708      T value = m_tunables.get();
709      try {
710        synchronized (m_buf) {
711          if (!m_schemaPublished) {
712            m_publisher.getTopic().getInstance().addSchema(m_buf.getStruct());
713            m_schemaPublished = true;
714          }
715          if (value == null) {
716            m_publisher.setRaw(new byte[0], 0, 0);
717          } else {
718            ByteBuffer bb = m_buf.write(value);
719            m_publisher.setRaw(bb, 0, bb.position());
720          }
721        }
722      } catch (RuntimeException e) {
723        reportWarning("failed to publish struct value", e);
724      }
725    }
726
727    @SuppressWarnings("PMD.AvoidCatchingGenericException")
728    @Override
729    public boolean doUpdateTunable(NetworkTableValue value) {
730      byte[] data = value.getRaw();
731      if (data.length == 0) {
732        m_tunables.set(null);
733        return true;
734      }
735      if (data.length != m_buf.getStruct().getSize()) {
736        reportWarning(
737            "rejected struct tune payload with "
738                + data.length
739                + " bytes; expected "
740                + m_buf.getStruct().getSize());
741        return false;
742      }
743      T tunedValue;
744      try {
745        synchronized (m_buf) {
746          tunedValue = m_buf.read(data);
747        }
748      } catch (RuntimeException e) {
749        reportWarning("rejected struct tune payload", e);
750        return false;
751      }
752      m_tunables.set(tunedValue);
753      return true;
754    }
755
756    private final Tunable.TunableStruct<T> m_tunables;
757    private final StructBuffer<T> m_buf;
758    private boolean m_schemaPublished;
759  }

761  private final class TunableStructArrayEntry<T> extends TunableValueEntry {
762    TunableStructArrayEntry(String path, Tunable.TunableStructArray<T> tunable) {
763      super(path, tunable, tunable.getConfig(), tunable.getStruct().getTypeString() + "[]");
764      m_tunables = tunable;
765      m_buf = StructBuffer.create(tunable.getStruct());
766      updateNetwork();
767    }
768
769    @SuppressWarnings("PMD.AvoidCatchingGenericException")
770    @Override
771    public void updateNetwork() {
772      T[] value = m_tunables.get();
773      if (value == null) {
774        if (m_hasPublishedValue) {
775          reportWarning("null struct array value was not published; previous value retained");
776        }
777        return;
778      }
779      try {
780        synchronized (m_buf) {
781          if (!m_schemaPublished) {
782            m_publisher.getTopic().getInstance().addSchema(m_buf.getStruct());
783            m_schemaPublished = true;
784          }
785          ByteBuffer bb = m_buf.writeArray(value);
786          m_publisher.setRaw(bb, 0, bb.position());
787          m_hasPublishedValue = true;
788        }
789      } catch (RuntimeException e) {
790        reportWarning("failed to publish struct array value", e);
791      }
792    }
793
794    @SuppressWarnings("PMD.AvoidCatchingGenericException")
795    @Override
796    public boolean doUpdateTunable(NetworkTableValue value) {
797      byte[] data = value.getRaw();
798      int size = m_buf.getStruct().getSize();
799      if (size == 0 || data.length % size != 0) {
800        reportWarning(
801            "rejected struct array tune payload with "
802                + data.length
803                + " bytes; expected a multiple of "
804                + size);
805        return false;
806      }
807      T[] tunedValue;
808      try {
809        synchronized (m_buf) {
810          tunedValue = m_buf.readArray(data);
811        }
812      } catch (RuntimeException e) {
813        reportWarning("rejected struct array tune payload", e);
814        return false;
815      }
816      m_tunables.set(tunedValue);
817      return true;
818    }
819
820    private final Tunable.TunableStructArray<T> m_tunables;
821    private final StructBuffer<T> m_buf;
822    private boolean m_schemaPublished;
823    private boolean m_hasPublishedValue;
824  }

887  private final class ComplexTunableEntry implements TunableEntry {
888    ComplexTunableEntry(String path, String legacyPath, ComplexTunable tunable) {
889      m_tunables = tunable;
890      String type = m_tunables.getTunableType();
891      if (type == null) {
892        m_typePublisher = null;
893      } else {
894        m_typePublisher =
895            m_inst.getStringTopic(path + "/.type").publishEx("string", MUTABLE_PROPERTIES);
896        m_typePublisher.set(type);
897      }
898      m_chooser =
899          "Selectable".equals(type) && !path.equals(legacyPath)
900              ? new ChooserCompatibility(path, legacyPath)
901              : null;
902    }
903
904    @Override
905    public void close() {
906      if (m_typePublisher != null) {
907        m_typePublisher.close();
908      }
909      if (m_chooser != null) {
910        m_chooser.close();
911      }
912    }
913
914    @Override
915    public void updateNetwork() {
916      TunableRegistry.updateComplexIfNeeded(m_tunables);
917    }

919    private final ComplexTunable m_tunables;

921    private final ChooserCompatibility m_chooser;
922  }

924  // Keep the legacy type in a separate table so existing Selectable dashboards
925  // can continue discovering the modern type and using its robust topics.
926  private final class ChooserCompatibility implements AutoCloseable {
927    private static final AtomicInteger NEXT_INSTANCE = new AtomicInteger();
928
929    ChooserCompatibility(String path, String legacyPath) {
930      m_default = m_inst.getStringTopic(path + "/default").subscribe("");
931      m_options = m_inst.getStringArrayTopic(path + "/options").subscribe(new String[0]);
932      m_active = m_inst.getStringTopic(path + "/selected/value").subscribe("");
933      m_tune = m_inst.getStringTopic(path + "/selected/tune").subscribe("");
934      m_tunePublisher = m_inst.getStringTopic(path + "/selected/tune").publish();
935      m_selectedPublisher = m_inst.getStringTopic(legacyPath + "/selected").publish();
936      m_selected =
937          m_inst
938              .getStringTopic(legacyPath + "/selected")
939              .subscribe("", PubSubOption.excludePublisher(m_selectedPublisher));
940      m_typePublisher = m_inst.getStringTopic(legacyPath + "/.type").publish();
941      m_namePublisher = m_inst.getStringTopic(legacyPath + "/.name").publish();
942      m_controllablePublisher = m_inst.getBooleanTopic(legacyPath + "/.controllable").publish();
943      m_instancePublisher = m_inst.getIntegerTopic(legacyPath + "/.instance").publish();
944      m_defaultPublisher = m_inst.getStringTopic(legacyPath + "/default").publish();
945      m_optionsPublisher = m_inst.getStringArrayTopic(legacyPath + "/options").publish();
946      m_activePublisher = m_inst.getStringTopic(legacyPath + "/active").publish();
947      m_typePublisher.set("String Chooser");
948      m_namePublisher.set(legacyPath.substring("/SmartDashboard/".length()));
949      m_controllablePublisher.set(true);
950      m_instancePublisher.set(NEXT_INSTANCE.getAndIncrement());
951      forwardSelection();
952    }
953
954    void forwardSelection() {
955      for (var selected : m_selected.readQueue()) {
956        // A retained legacy request must not overwrite a newer modern request.
957        // Accept equal timestamps so selections work when simulation time is paused.
958        if (selected.timestamp >= m_tune.getAtomic().timestamp) {
959          m_tunePublisher.set(selected.value, selected.timestamp);
960        }
961      }
962    }
963
964    void updateNetwork() {
965      String defaultChoice = m_default.get();
966      String[] options = m_options.get();
967      String selected = m_active.get();
968      m_selectedPublisher.set(selected);
969      m_defaultPublisher.set(defaultChoice);
970      m_optionsPublisher.set(options);
971      m_activePublisher.set(
972          !selected.isEmpty() && Arrays.asList(options).contains(selected)
973              ? selected
974              : defaultChoice);
975    }
976
977    @Override
978    public void close() {
979      m_default.close();
980      m_options.close();
981      m_active.close();
982      m_tune.close();
983      m_tunePublisher.close();
984      m_selected.close();
985      m_selectedPublisher.close();
986      m_typePublisher.close();
987      m_namePublisher.close();
988      m_controllablePublisher.close();
989      m_instancePublisher.close();
990      m_defaultPublisher.close();
991      m_optionsPublisher.close();
992      m_activePublisher.close();
993    }
994
995    private final StringSubscriber m_default;
996    private final StringArraySubscriber m_options;
997    private final StringSubscriber m_active;
998    private final StringSubscriber m_tune;
999    private final StringPublisher m_tunePublisher;
1000    private final StringSubscriber m_selected;
1001    private final StringPublisher m_selectedPublisher;
1002    private final StringPublisher m_typePublisher;
1003    private final StringPublisher m_namePublisher;
1004    private final BooleanPublisher m_controllablePublisher;
1005    private final IntegerPublisher m_instancePublisher;
1006    private final StringPublisher m_defaultPublisher;
1007    private final StringArrayPublisher m_optionsPublisher;
1008    private final StringPublisher m_activePublisher;
1009  }

1011  /**
1012   * Construct.
1013   *
1014   * @param inst NetworkTables instance
1015   * @param prefix prefix to put in front of tunable paths in NT
1016   */
1017  public NetworkTablesTunableBackend(NetworkTableInstance inst, String prefix) {
1018    m_inst = inst;
1019    m_prefix = prefix;
1020    m_poller = new NetworkTableListenerPoller(inst);
1021  }
1022
1023  private boolean hasActiveEntry(String path) {
1024    StoredEntry entry = m_entries.get(path);
1025    return entry != null && !entry.closed;
1026  }
1027
1028  private boolean hasQueuedActiveEntry(String path) {
1029    if (m_updateDepth > 0) {
1030      Boolean pendingState = m_pendingPathStates.get(path);
1031      if (pendingState != null) {
1032        return pendingState;
1033      }
1034    }
1035    return hasActiveEntry(path);
1036  }
1037
1038  private void trackEntry(StoredEntry entry) {
1039    if (entry.tunable == null) {
1040      m_complexEntries.add(entry);
1041      return;
1042    }
1043
1044    if (isAlwaysGet(entry.tunable)) {
1045      m_alwaysGetEntries.add(entry);
1046    } else if (entry.tunable.supportsChangeNotification()) {
1047      m_entriesByTunable.computeIfAbsent(entry.tunable, k -> new ArrayList<>()).add(entry);
1048      if (entry.tunable.hasChanged()) {
1049        enqueueDirtyEntry(entry);
1050      }
1051    } else {
1052      m_polledEntries.add(entry);
1053    }
1054  }
1055
1056  private void untrackEntry(StoredEntry entry) {
1057    m_dirtyEntries.remove(entry);
1058    entry.dirtyQueued = false;
1059
1060    if (entry.tunable == null) {
1061      m_complexEntries.remove(entry);
1062      return;
1063    }
1064
1065    if (isAlwaysGet(entry.tunable)) {
1066      m_alwaysGetEntries.remove(entry);
1067    } else if (entry.tunable.supportsChangeNotification()) {
1068      List<StoredEntry> entries = m_entriesByTunable.get(entry.tunable);
1069      if (entries != null) {
1070        entries.remove(entry);
1071        if (entries.isEmpty()) {
1072          m_entriesByTunable.remove(entry.tunable);
1073        }
1074      }
1075    } else {
1076      m_polledEntries.remove(entry);
1077    }
1078  }
1079
1080  private void clearTrackedEntries() {
1081    m_entries.clear();
1082    m_entriesByTunable.clear();
1083    m_dirtyEntries.clear();
1084    m_alwaysGetEntries.clear();
1085    m_complexEntries.clear();
1086    m_polledEntries.clear();
1087  }
1088
1089  private void enqueueDirtyEntry(StoredEntry entry) {
1090    if (!entry.closed && !entry.dirtyQueued) {
1091      entry.dirtyQueued = true;
1092      m_dirtyEntries.add(entry);
1093    }
1094  }
1095
1096  private void closeEntry(StoredEntry entry) {
1097    if (entry.closed) {
1098      return;
1099    }
1100    entry.closed = true;
1101    entry.entry.close();
1102    if (m_updateDepth == 0) {
1103      untrackEntry(entry);
1104    }
1105  }
1106
1107  private void eraseEntry(String path, StoredEntry entry) {
1108    if (m_updateDepth > 0) {
1109      m_pendingPathStates.put(path, false);
1110      m_pendingMutations.add(() -> eraseEntryNow(path, entry));
1111    } else {
1112      eraseEntryNow(path, entry);
1113    }
1114  }
1115
1116  @SuppressWarnings("PMD.CompareObjectsWithEquals")
1117  private void eraseEntryNow(String path, StoredEntry entry) {
1118    if (m_entries.get(path) == entry) {
1119      m_entries.remove(path);
1120      untrackEntry(entry);
1121    }
1122  }
1123
1124  private void applyPendingMutations() {
1125    try {
1126      while (!m_pendingMutations.isEmpty()) {
1127        List<Runnable> mutations = new ArrayList<>(m_pendingMutations);
1128        m_pendingMutations.clear();
1129        for (Runnable mutation : mutations) {
1130          mutation.run();
1131        }
1132      }
1133    } finally {
1134      m_pendingPathStates.clear();
1135    }
1136  }
1137
1138  @Override
1139  public void close() {
1140    synchronized (m_entries) {
1141      if (m_closed) {
1142        return;
1143      }
1144      m_closed = true;
1145      m_pendingMutations.clear();
1146      m_pendingPathStates.clear();
1147      for (StoredEntry entry : m_entries.values()) {
1148        closeEntry(entry);
1149      }
1150      if (m_updateDepth > 0) {
1151        m_pendingMutations.add(this::clearTrackedEntries);
1152      } else {
1153        clearTrackedEntries();
1154      }
1155      m_subscriberMap.clear();
1156      m_pendingTuneEvents.clear();
1157      m_poller.close();
1158    }
1159  }
1160
1161  @Override
1162  public boolean publish(String path, TunableBase tunable) {
1163    InitialUpdate initialUpdate;
1164    synchronized (m_entries) {
1165      if (m_closed) {
1166        return false;
1167      }
1168      if (hasQueuedActiveEntry(path)) {
1169        TunableRegistry.reportWarning(
1170            "NetworkTables tunable '" + m_prefix + path + "' already exists");
1171        return false;
1172      }
1173      if (m_updateDepth > 0) {
1174        m_pendingPathStates.put(path, true);
1175        m_pendingMutations.add(() -> publish(path, tunable));
1176        return true;
1177      }
1178      String ntPath = m_prefix + path;
1179      TunableValueEntry entry;
1180      switch (tunable) {
1181        case TunableBoolean v -> entry = new TunableBooleanEntry(ntPath, v, v.getConfig(), v, v);
1182        case TunableInt v -> entry = new TunableIntEntry(ntPath, v, v.getConfig(), v, v);
1183        case TunableLong v -> entry = new TunableLongEntry(ntPath, v, v.getConfig(), v, v);
1184        case TunableFloat v -> entry = new TunableFloatEntry(ntPath, v, v.getConfig(), v, v);
1185        case TunableDouble v -> entry = new TunableDoubleEntry(ntPath, v, v.getConfig(), v, v);
1186        case Tunable.TunableStruct<?> v -> entry = new TunableStructEntry<>(ntPath, v);
1187        case Tunable.TunableStructArray<?> v -> entry = new TunableStructArrayEntry<>(ntPath, v);
1188        case Tunable.TunableProtobuf<?> v -> entry = new TunableProtobufEntry<>(ntPath, v);
1189        case Tunable<?> t -> {
1190          Class<?> cls = t.getTypeClass();
1191          if (cls == null) {
1192            TunableRegistry.reportWarning("Tunable type <null> is not supported by NetworkTables");
1193            return false;
1194          }
1195          switch (cls) {
1196            case Class<?> c when c == String.class -> {
1197              @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
1198              Tunable<String> tt = (Tunable<String>) t;
1199              entry =
1200                  new NullableTunableValueEntry<>(
1201                      ntPath,
1202                      tt,
1203                      "string",
1204                      GenericPublisher::setString,
1205                      NetworkTableValue::getString);
1206            }
1207            case Class<?> c when c == byte[].class -> {
1208              @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
1209              Tunable<byte[]> tt = (Tunable<byte[]>) t;
1210              entry = new TunableRawEntry(ntPath, tt);
1211            }
1212            case Class<?> c when c == boolean[].class -> {
1213              @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
1214              Tunable<boolean[]> tt = (Tunable<boolean[]>) t;
1215              entry = new TunableBooleanArrayEntry(ntPath, tt);
1216            }
1217            case Class<?> c when c == int[].class -> {
1218              @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
1219              Tunable<int[]> tt = (Tunable<int[]>) t;
1220              entry = new TunableIntArrayEntry(ntPath, tt);
1221            }
1222            case Class<?> c when c == long[].class -> {
1223              @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
1224              Tunable<long[]> tt = (Tunable<long[]>) t;
1225              entry = new TunableLongArrayEntry(ntPath, tt);
1226            }
1227            case Class<?> c when c == float[].class -> {
1228              @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
1229              Tunable<float[]> tt = (Tunable<float[]>) t;
1230              entry = new TunableFloatArrayEntry(ntPath, tt);
1231            }
1232            case Class<?> c when c == double[].class -> {
1233              @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
1234              Tunable<double[]> tt = (Tunable<double[]>) t;
1235              entry = new TunableDoubleArrayEntry(ntPath, tt);
1236            }
1237            case Class<?> c when c == String[].class -> {
1238              @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
1239              Tunable<String[]> tt = (Tunable<String[]>) t;
1240              entry = new TunableStringArrayEntry(ntPath, tt);
1241            }
1242            case Class<?> c when c == Boolean.class -> {
1243              @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
1244              Tunable<Boolean> tt = (Tunable<Boolean>) t;
1245              entry =
1246                  new NullableTunableValueEntry<>(
1247                      ntPath,
1248                      tt,
1249                      "boolean",
1250                      GenericPublisher::setBoolean,
1251                      NetworkTableValue::getBoolean);
1252            }
1253            case Class<?> c when c == Integer.class -> {
1254              @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
1255              Tunable<Integer> tt = (Tunable<Integer>) t;
1256              entry =
1257                  new NullableTunableValueEntry<>(
1258                      ntPath,
1259                      tt,
1260                      "int",
1261                      GenericPublisher::setInteger,
1262                      value -> (int) value.getInteger());
1263            }
1264            case Class<?> c when c == Long.class -> {
1265              @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
1266              Tunable<Long> tt = (Tunable<Long>) t;
1267              entry =
1268                  new NullableTunableValueEntry<>(
1269                      ntPath,
1270                      tt,
1271                      "int",
1272                      GenericPublisher::setInteger,
1273                      NetworkTableValue::getInteger);
1274            }
1275            case Class<?> c when c == Float.class -> {
1276              @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
1277              Tunable<Float> tt = (Tunable<Float>) t;
1278              entry =
1279                  new NullableTunableValueEntry<>(
1280                      ntPath, tt, "float", GenericPublisher::setFloat, NetworkTableValue::getFloat);
1281            }
1282            case Class<?> c when c == Double.class -> {
1283              @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
1284              Tunable<Double> tt = (Tunable<Double>) t;
1285              entry =
1286                  new NullableTunableValueEntry<>(
1287                      ntPath,
1288                      tt,
1289                      "double",
1290                      GenericPublisher::setDouble,
1291                      NetworkTableValue::getDouble);
1292            }
1293            default -> {
1294              TunableRegistry.reportWarning(
1295                  "Tunable type "
1296                      + t.getTypeClass().getName()
1297                      + " is not supported by NetworkTables");
1298              return false;
1299            }
1300          }
1301        }
1302        default -> {
1303          TunableRegistry.reportWarning(
1304              "Tunable implementation "
1305                  + tunable.getClass().getName()
1306                  + " is not supported by NetworkTables");
1307          return false;
1308        }
1309      }
1310      StoredEntry storedEntry = new StoredEntry(entry, tunable, null);
1311      m_entries.put(path, storedEntry);
1312      trackEntry(storedEntry);
1313      initialUpdate = entry.updateInitialTunable();
1314      if (initialUpdate != null) {
1315        entry.updateNetwork();
1316      }
1317    }
1318
1319    if (initialUpdate != null && initialUpdate.callback() != null) {
1320      TunableRegistry.runAfterUpdate(initialUpdate.callback());
1321    }
1322    return true;
1323  }
1324
1325  @Override
1326  public boolean publishComplex(String path, ComplexTunable tunable) {
1327    synchronized (m_entries) {
1328      if (m_closed) {
1329        return false;
1330      }
1331      if (hasQueuedActiveEntry(path)) {
1332        TunableRegistry.reportWarning(
1333            "NetworkTables tunable '" + m_prefix + path + "' already exists");
1334        return false;
1335      }
1336      if (m_updateDepth > 0) {
1337        m_pendingPathStates.put(path, true);
1338        m_pendingMutations.add(() -> publishComplex(path, tunable));
1339        return true;
1340      }
1341      StoredEntry storedEntry =
1342          new StoredEntry(
1343              new ComplexTunableEntry(m_prefix + path, "/SmartDashboard" + path, tunable),
1344              null,
1345              tunable);
1346      m_entries.put(path, storedEntry);
1347      trackEntry(storedEntry);
1348    }
1349
1350    TunableRegistry.publishComplexChildren(path, tunable);
1351    return true;
1352  }
1353
1354  @Override
1355  public void remove(String path) {
1356    synchronized (m_entries) {
1357      if (m_closed) {
1358        return;
1359      }
1360      StoredEntry entry = m_entries.get(path);
1361      if (entry != null && !entry.closed) {
1362        closeEntry(entry);
1363        eraseEntry(path, entry);
1364      } else if (m_updateDepth > 0 && Boolean.TRUE.equals(m_pendingPathStates.get(path))) {
1365        m_pendingPathStates.put(path, false);
1366        m_pendingMutations.add(() -> remove(path));
1367      }
1368    }
1369  }
1370
1371  @Override
1372  public List<PublishedTunable> removePrefix(String prefix) {
1373    String normalizedPrefix = PathUtil.normalizePrefix(prefix);
1374    List<PublishedTunable> removed = new ArrayList<>();
1375    synchronized (m_entries) {
1376      var iterator = m_entries.entrySet().iterator();
1377      while (iterator.hasNext()) {
1378        var mapEntry = iterator.next();
1379        if (!PathUtil.isPathOrDescendant(mapEntry.getKey(), normalizedPrefix)) {
1380          continue;
1381        }
1382        StoredEntry entry = mapEntry.getValue();
1383        if (entry.closed) {
1384          continue;
1385        }
1386        removed.add(new PublishedTunable(mapEntry.getKey(), entry.tunable, entry.complex));
1387        closeEntry(entry);
1388        if (m_updateDepth > 0) {
1389          String path = mapEntry.getKey();
1390          m_pendingMutations.add(() -> eraseEntryNow(path, entry));
1391        } else {
1392          iterator.remove();
1393        }
1394      }
1395      if (m_updateDepth > 0) {
1396        List<String> pendingRemoves = new ArrayList<>();
1397        for (var pendingEntry : m_pendingPathStates.entrySet()) {
1398          if (pendingEntry.getValue()
1399              && PathUtil.isPathOrDescendant(pendingEntry.getKey(), normalizedPrefix)) {
1400            pendingRemoves.add(pendingEntry.getKey());
1401          }
1402        }
1403        for (String path : pendingRemoves) {
1404          m_pendingPathStates.put(path, false);
1405          m_pendingMutations.add(() -> remove(path));
1406        }
1407      }
1408    }
1409    return removed;
1410  }
1411
1412  @Override
1413  public void markDirty(TunableBase tunable) {
1414    synchronized (m_entries) {
1415      if (m_closed || isAlwaysGet(tunable) || !tunable.supportsChangeNotification()) {
1416        return;
1417      }
1418      List<StoredEntry> entries = m_entriesByTunable.get(tunable);
1419      if (entries == null) {
1420        return;
1421      }
1422      for (StoredEntry entry : entries) {
1423        enqueueDirtyEntry(entry);
1424      }
1425    }
1426  }
1427
1428  private void updateComplexEntries() {
1429    try {
1430      m_updatedComplexEntries.clear();
1431      for (StoredEntry entry : m_complexEntries) {
1432        if (!entry.closed && m_updatedComplexEntries.put(entry.complex, Boolean.TRUE) == null) {
1433          entry.entry.updateNetwork();
1434        }
1435      }
1436    } finally {
1437      m_updatedComplexEntries.clear();
1438    }
1439  }
1440
1441  private void updateAlwaysGetEntries() {
1442    for (StoredEntry entry : m_alwaysGetEntries) {
1443      if (!entry.closed) {
1444        entry.entry.updateNetwork();
1445        if (entry.tunable.hasChanged()) {
1446          TunableRegistry.resetChangedAfterUpdate(entry.tunable);
1447        }
1448      }
1449    }
1450  }
1451
1452  private void updatePolledEntries() {
1453    for (StoredEntry entry : m_polledEntries) {
1454      if (!entry.closed && entry.tunable.hasChanged()) {
1455        entry.entry.updateNetwork();
1456        TunableRegistry.resetChangedAfterUpdate(entry.tunable);
1457      }
1458    }
1459  }
1460
1461  private void updateDirtyEntries() {
1462    for (StoredEntry entry : m_dirtyEntries) {
1463      entry.dirtyQueued = false;
1464      if (!entry.closed && entry.tunable.hasChanged()) {
1465        entry.entry.updateNetwork();
1466        TunableRegistry.resetChangedAfterUpdate(entry.tunable);
1467      }
1468    }
1469    m_dirtyEntries.clear();
1470  }
1471
1472  private void processTuneEvent(NetworkTableEvent event, List<Runnable> onChangeCallbacks) {
1473    if (event.valueData == null || event.valueData.value == null) {
1474      return;
1475    }
1476    TunableValueEntry entry = m_subscriberMap.get(event.valueData.subentry);
1477    if (entry == null) {
1478      return;
1479    }
1480    Runnable callback = entry.updateTunable(event.valueData.value);
1481    if (callback == null) {
1482      return;
1483    }
1484    onChangeCallbacks.add(callback);
1485  }
1486
1487  private void processTuneEvents(NetworkTableEvent[] events, List<Runnable> onChangeCallbacks) {
1488    for (NetworkTableEvent event : events) {
1489      processTuneEvent(event, onChangeCallbacks);
1490    }
1491  }
1492
1493  private void scheduleOnChangeCallbacks(List<Runnable> onChangeCallbacks) {
1494    for (Runnable callback : onChangeCallbacks) {
1495      TunableRegistry.runAfterUpdate(callback);
1496    }
1497  }
1498
1499  private List<Runnable> acquireOnChangeCallbacks() {
1500    if (m_usingOnChangeCallbacks) {
1501      return new ArrayList<>();
1502    }
1503    m_usingOnChangeCallbacks = true;
1504    m_onChangeCallbacks.clear();
1505    return m_onChangeCallbacks;
1506  }
1507
1508  @SuppressWarnings("PMD.CompareObjectsWithEquals")
1509  private void releaseOnChangeCallbacks(List<Runnable> onChangeCallbacks) {
1510    onChangeCallbacks.clear();
1511    synchronized (m_entries) {
1512      if (onChangeCallbacks == m_onChangeCallbacks) {
1513        m_usingOnChangeCallbacks = false;
1514      }
1515    }
1516  }
1517
1518  @Override
1519  public void update() {
1520    List<Runnable> onChangeCallbacks;
1521    synchronized (m_entries) {
1522      onChangeCallbacks = acquireOnChangeCallbacks();
1523    }
1524    try {
1525      synchronized (m_entries) {
1526        if (m_closed) {
1527          return;
1528        }
1529        // update tunables from network changes
1530        for (StoredEntry entry : m_complexEntries) {
1531          var complex = (ComplexTunableEntry) entry.entry;
1532          if (!entry.closed && complex.m_chooser != null) {
1533            complex.m_chooser.forwardSelection();
1534          }
1535        }
1536        var pendingEvents = m_pendingTuneEvents.toArray(NetworkTableEvent[]::new);
1537        m_pendingTuneEvents.clear();
1538        var events = m_poller.readQueue();
1539        processTuneEvents(pendingEvents, onChangeCallbacks);
1540        processTuneEvents(events, onChangeCallbacks);
1541
1542        // update network from tunable changes
1543        // updateNetwork() can run user getters or complex update code that re-enters this backend.
1544        m_updateDepth++;
1545        try {
1546          updateComplexEntries();
1547          updateAlwaysGetEntries();
1548          updatePolledEntries();
1549          updateDirtyEntries();
1550          for (StoredEntry entry : m_complexEntries) {
1551            var complex = (ComplexTunableEntry) entry.entry;
1552            if (!entry.closed && complex.m_chooser != null) {
1553              complex.m_chooser.updateNetwork();
1554            }
1555          }
1556        } finally {
1557          m_updateDepth--;
1558          if (m_updateDepth == 0) {
1559            applyPendingMutations();
1560          }
1561        }
1562      }
1563
1564      // onTune callbacks can publish or remove tunables, so run them without the backend lock held.
1565      scheduleOnChangeCallbacks(onChangeCallbacks);
1566    } finally {
1567      releaseOnChangeCallbacks(onChangeCallbacks);
1568    }
1569  }
1570}
